shellCommands.command: pwd && rg --files -g '!node_modules' | head -80 && printf '\n--- package ---\n' && sed -n '1,220p' package.json

find src -type f -maxdepth 4 -print | sort && printf '\n--- relevant references ---\n' && grep -RInE "touchstart|mouseenter|mouseover|scroll|resize|showDelay|delayShow|setTimeout|anchor" src --exclude='*.css' | head -240

sed -n '1,240p' src/components/Tooltip/event-delegation.ts && printf '
--- Tooltip timer lifecycle ---
' && sed -n '1,360p' src/components/Tooltip/Tooltip.tsx && printf '
--- timeout util ---
' && sed -n '1,120p' src/utils/clear-timeout-ref.ts && printf '
--- relevant tests ---
' && sed -n '1,180p' src/test/tooltip-anchor-selection.spec.js && sed -n '1,260p' src/test/tooltip-close-and-delay-behavior.spec.js

sed -n '240,680p' src/components/Tooltip/Tooltip.tsx && printf '
--- types ---
' && sed -n '1,180p' src/components/Tooltip/TooltipTypes.d.ts && printf '
--- test utils ---
' && sed -n '1,150p' src/test/test-utils.js && printf '
--- git status ---
' && git status --short
grep -RInE "\btouch\b|touchstart|touchend" src README.md docs 2>/dev/null | head -200; grep -RInE "touch" . --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git --exclude='yarn.lock' | head -200
